intro.h2: When a bathroom has to be done right
paragraphs: Frias Remodeling LLC does bathroom remodeling in Palm Beach County, Florida, along with porcelain and tile floors. The bathrooms on its Google profile show floor-to-ceiling marble-look porcelain, glass shower enclosures, matte black fixtures and clean built-in niches.

One family came to Frias after a small bathroom project by a different contractor had failed. They were on high alert, but Javier quickly showed them they had found the right group. He kept them up to date at every step, consulted them and made great recommendations. They say they will definitely be working with Frias for many projects to come, and other customers say the same.

services.h2: Bathroom and tile work we do

items.name: Complete bathroom remodels
items.blurb: From the shower walls to the toilet and mirror, Frias Remodeling handles the whole room. The finished bathrooms on its profile pair large marble-look porcelain panels with dark mosaic shower floors, glass enclosures and simple black fixtures for a clean, modern look.

image.alt: Remodeled bathroom with glass shower, marble-look porcelain walls, dark mosaic shower floor and new toilet

items.name: Walk-in showers
items.blurb: A walk-in shower is often the heart of a bathroom remodel. The showers shown here have large-format porcelain walls, a rain shower head, a handheld sprayer, a recessed niche for bottles and a window kept bright with a tiled sill.

image.alt: Walk-in shower with rain shower head, black handheld sprayer and tiled window sill in marble-look porcelain

items.name: Vanities and finishing touches
items.blurb: The details finish the room. One bathroom on the Frias profile has a walnut vanity with a white top, brass faucets and two round mirrors set against marble-look walls. Ask how your vanity, mirrors and fixtures can tie the space together.

image.alt: Walnut vanity with white top, brass faucets and two round mirrors on marble-look porcelain walls

items.name: Porcelain and tile floors
items.blurb: Floors are a big part of the work. Javier and Felix installed porcelain floors throughout one customer's property, and another homeowner called his new floor tile absolutely stunning and a seamless job. Large white marble-look and wood-look tiles both appear in their photos.

image.alt: Large glossy white marble-look porcelain floor tiles

about.text: Frias Remodeling LLC is a bathroom remodeler that, in its own words on Instagram, is transforming homes in Palm Beach County, Florida. Customers name Javier and Felix as the people on the job. Reviewers describe them as professional and meticulous, and say the work looks stunning. Some homeowners find Frias through friends after a bad experience with another contractor, and others come back for project after project. The company works Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 5:30 PM and Saturday mornings, and you can reach it by phone, email, Facebook or Instagram.

service_area.h2: Serving homeowners across Palm Beach County
service_area.text: Frias Remodeling LLC works in homes across Palm Beach County, Florida, as its Instagram profile says. The Google listing has no shop address and no list of towns, so the crew comes to you. If you are not sure whether your home is in their area, call (561) 460-7815 between Monday and Saturday and ask before you book a visit.

items.a: Frias Remodeling LLC works in Palm Beach County, Florida. There is no showroom address listed, because the work happens at your home. If you are unsure whether your town is covered, call (561) 460-7815 or send an email and the team will let you know.

items.q: Can you fix a bathroom another contractor left unfinished?
items.a: Yes. One family hired Frias after a small bathroom project by a different contractor failed. Javier kept them updated at every step and made recommendations along the way, and they say they found the right group to fix it. The owner replied that they were glad to turn it around.

items.q: Do you install tile floors outside the bathroom?
items.a: Yes. Javier and Felix installed porcelain floors throughout one customer's property, and another homeowner had new floor tiles installed that he describes as absolutely stunning. The photos show both large white marble-look tiles and wood-look porcelain planks, so ask about the rooms you have in mind.

Frias Remodeling LLC is open Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 5:30 PM and Saturday from 8:30 AM to 1 PM. It is closed on Sunday. You can call (561) 460-7815 during those hours or send an email at any time.

items.q: Will I know what is happening during the project?
items.a: That is what customers point out. Louis G. writes that Javier kept his family up to date throughout every step of their bathroom project, consulted them and made great recommendations. Ask any questions you have at the start, and you will be kept informed as the work moves along.
